summary: BTC ~$77.0k, down ~5% in 24h. Coinbase Premium hit -0.27% on 29 Oct, its lowest in four years, pointing to US selling after the $6.3B Binance hack; Fear & Greed 30. Binance says SAFU covers losses and withdrawals resume within ~48h. Some call capitulation, but no fresh bullish catalyst.
catalyst_note: Binance $6.3B hack disclosed 29 Oct; withdrawals due to resume ~31 Oct
